verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a desktop API client like Insomnia, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking controls. The related privacy items (Local Vault and Git Sync storage, servers unable to read synced data, no login for Scratch Pad) are adjacent data-storage features, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
